events.title: Manager Mark Wotte leaves Dutch club 빌럼 II Tilburg and becomes technical director at 페예노르트 .

Gordon Strachan announced that he would not renew his contract as 사우샘프턴 manager when it expired at the end of the season, amid speculation that he will return to his old club Leeds as their new manager .
맨체스터 시티 signed goalkeeper David James from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 for £2 million, prompting the retirement of 40-year-old David Seaman .
맨체스터 유나이티드 signed 풀럼 striker 루이 사아 for £12.8 million.
Hungarian footballer Miklós Fehér dies in a match between 벤피카 and Vitória Guimarães in Portugal. 벤피카 will subsequently retire his number 29 shirt.
아스널 signed 세비야 striker 호세 안토니오 레예스 for £10.5 million.
Dutch club Volendam sacks manager Henk Wisman . Former player Johan Steur is named interim-manager.
첼시 signed Charlton midfielder 스콧 파커 for £10 million.

맨체스터 유나이티드 topped the Premier League, with unbeaten 아스널 a point behind and a game in hand. 첼시's bid for the title took a setback; they were in third place with a seven-point gap between them and the top spot followed by Charlton and 리버풀. Leeds, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 레스터 시티 occupied the bottom three places. 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 were still leading the way at the top of Division One. 셰필드 유나이티드, 선덜랜드, 입스위치 타운 and 위건 애슬레틱 occupied the play-off zone.
